cards.prose: Luke dates the hour by emperors and high priests, and then says *the word of Elohim (God) came unto John* in the wilderness. Isaiah had put a voice in that very place, *him that crieth in the wilderness*, with the call *Prepare ye the way of Yahuah (LORD)*, and Luke goes on to hang Isaiah's words on John. The word arrives where Isaiah said the crying would be.
cards.member_phrase: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of Yahuah (LORD)
cards.member_sentence: Isaiah's voice crying in the wilderness is the place and the work Luke gives John when the word of Elohim (God) comes to him there.

cards.prose: Luke says John spoke to *the multitude that came forth to be baptized* (Luke 3:7), where Matthew names Pharisees and Sadducees. Either way fruit comes first, and no one hides behind *We have Abraham to our father*. The stones read well beside Hosea: *Ye are the sons of the living Elohim (God)* (Hosea 1:10), said in the place where they were not his people.
cards.member_sentence: John tells them not to rest on having Abraham as father, because Elohim (God) is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
cards.flag: The Matthew 3 thread's summary still reads the stones as the nations grafted in; this card is written as the scattered house called back (Hosea 1:10), per the brief. That summary needs rewriting.
